description: 1D dam break on a flat frictionless bed, h_l = 0.5 m, h_r = 0 m, dam at x = 20 m, hydrostatic SFLOW (A 220 0), WENO reconstruction; depth time series at 8 gauges for 0 < t < 4 s against the exact Ritter (dry bed) solution.

reference.citation: Ritter, A. (1892) Die Fortpflanzung der Wasserwellen. Z. Verein Deutscher Ing. 36; exact solution as in Delestre et al. (2013) SWASHES, Int. J. Numer. Meth. Fluids 72, 269-300
